notes: Cohesive aggregate: the six resonance effects have no individual IDs, so they are one file keyed by the geode's material.

`shortModifier` on each entry is transcribed from the duplicate table at docs/61-specialized-resource-identities.md:94-101 (section 'Geode resonance behavior'), which is an abbreviated restatement of the same six 20% modifiers.

Divergence between the two tables: docs/61:94-101 omits every named effect (Focused Assault, Dense Plating, Charged Payloads, Vector Lock, Synchronized Aggression, Overclocked Motion) and omits the two non-coupling qualifiers docs/40 states - Eidolon Coral is '20% faster without increasing movement speed' and Flux Amber is '20% higher without increasing attack cadence'. No numeric value diverges; both tables state 20% for all six. docs/40 is used as authoritative because docs/61:103 points back to it.
materialId is the letter code from the identity map at docs/61-specialized-resource-identities.md:20-27; docs/40's table names materials only.
modifier.direction is derived from the doc's own wording ('higher', 'lower', 'less', 'faster').

fieldRules.radiusMeters is null: docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:48 leaves the exact mining-zone radius and any resource-specific size variation open, and no doc gives the resonance field radius beyond 'larger than its extraction zone'.
The 20% modifiers are explicitly initial playtest values (docs/40-mining-and-extraction.md:111); their common magnitude does not assert equal practical difficulty.

effects.edgeCaseRule: Reduces incoming damage only while the enemy remains inside the field and never restores health when the effect ends.
Bonus projectile damage is determined when the empowered enemy creates the projectile; that projectile retains the decided damage after crossing the boundary.

effects.resonanceEffect: player-imposed displacement magnitude and control-effect duration are 20% lower
effects.edgeCaseRule: Reduces both forced-movement magnitude and timed control duration without granting immunity.

effects.resonanceEffect: enemy attack cadence is 20% faster without increasing movement speed
enemy movement speed is 20% higher without increasing attack cadence
